name: Glance RPO with Orbit Return Motion
formation: 11P Condensed Bunch Right with Orbit Motion

summary.motive: Punish aggressive run-stopping linebackers by reading the apex/Will defender on a post-snap RPO, pairing interior Duo power with a rapid Glance slant route.
summary.whyItWorks: Pre-snap orbit motion holds the strong safety while the Duo run mesh pulls the Will linebacker downhill, creating an uncontested throwing window on the skinny slant to X.
summary.failureMode: Will linebacker staying disciplined in the slant throwing lane while defensive front stuffs the Duo run with a light box, or quarterback misreading the conflict key and forcing a contested throw.

beats.title: 1. The Orbit Motion Displacement
beats.text: Z fires in rapid pre-snap orbit motion across the backfield. The Nickel defender and Strong Safety are forced to widen their alignment and hesitate, opening up the weakside second level.

beats.title: 2. The Post-Snap Conflict Read
beats.text: The QB meshes with the RB on a Duo track while reading the Will linebacker. Seeing the Will crash downhill into the B-gap to stop the power run, the QB instantly pulls the ball.

beats.title: 3. The Quick Glance Strike
beats.text: The QB plants and fires a quick-release dart on a 6-yard Glance slant to X, hitting him in the vacant window directly vacated by the crashing Will linebacker.

beats.title: 4. Red Zone Touchdown Burst
beats.text: X snatches the ball in stride, defeats the off-balance boundary corner, and slices between the closing safeties for an explosive 28-yard red-zone touchdown.

relations.tell: Pre-snap orbit motion across the backfield paired with post-snap mesh read; QB keeps eyes glued on the conflict apex linebacker.
